page.overview:
What is Ergamon?

Roreca described Ergamon as having "colossal peaks and exotic fauna". The planeswalker Worzel dueled Thomil at least once on this plane. It was also invaded by Phyrexians during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse. The only known location on Ergamon is the Truga Jungle.

Ergamon is a plane "filled with wild animals" though no bears including a race of Rhinos that defended their world during New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse. Curiously, the ecosystem, predator and prey alike, worked in tandem to repel the invaders, an abnormal behavior that suggests some higher power or greater design.
